privacy.applyNotice: We use your details for this application. Read in our <link>privacy statement</link> how long we keep them and what your rights are.
privacy.registerNotice: We use your details to find suitable work for you. Read in our <link>privacy statement</link> how long we keep them and what your rights are.
privacy.staffRequestNotice: We only use your details to handle your request. Read in our <link>privacy statement</link> how we handle them.
privacy.contactNotice: We only use your details to answer your message. Read in our <link>privacy statement</link> how we handle them.

talentPool.label: Keep my details for one year so Groos can contact me about other suitable work.
talentPool.hint: This is optional. You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing {email}.

registerConsent.label: I give Groos permission to keep my details for one year and to contact me about suitable work.
registerConsent.hint: Without this permission we cannot keep your registration. You can withdraw it at any time via {email}.

lastName.label: Last name

apply.title: Apply for
apply.intro: It only takes a few minutes and you do not need a CV. Our team will call or message you to get to know you.

alternatives.title: Prefer to call or message?
alternatives.body: That works too. Mention job {number} so we know what it is about.

meta.title: Register or apply openly
meta.description: Register with Groos and tell us what work you are looking for and when you can start. Registering is free and you do not need a CV.

register.title: Register for work
register.intro: Can you not find a job that suits you? Register once and we will call you as soon as there is suitable work.
benefits: You do not need a CV
You have one dedicated point of contact
register.formAccent: what work you are looking for

occupations.legend: What work are you interested in?
occupations.hint: Choose one or more occupations, or skip this if you are not sure yet.

alternatives.title: Prefer to call or message?
alternatives.body: Tell us by phone or WhatsApp what work you are looking for. That works just as well.

items.title: We call you
items.body: We call or message you to hear what work you are looking for.

items.title: We look for suitable work
items.body: We look at which work fits your experience, your hours and where you live.

items.title: You start working
items.body: We agree on your first working day and tell you what to bring.

meta.title: Request staff
meta.description: Tell us which people you need, from when and for how long. We will then contact you to discuss your request and the start date of the work.

staffRequest.title: Request staff
staffRequest.intro: Tell us which people you need, from when and for how long. We will then contact you to go through the request.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: We call you on this number about the request.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: We send your confirmation to this address.

kvkNumber.label: Chamber of Commerce (KvK) number
kvkNumber.hint: Eight digits, only if you have it to hand.

occupations.hint: You can choose more than one occupation.

occupationOther.label: Other work
occupationOther.hint: Do you need someone for other work? Describe it briefly here.

description.label: Further details
description.hint: For example working hours, tasks or requirements such as VCA or a driving licence.

alternatives.body: Call or message our team. We will then go through your request with you by phone.
